References / Poster / 568

Viktor Hachmang, poster for Trailer/Min Expo

A riso-printed exhibition poster by the Dutch illustrator Viktor Hachmang: fluorescent pink and dark blue, with coarse halftone dots and overprinted violet.

Source
Flickr: Marcel van Schooten, “Poster Trailer/Min Expo”
Creator
Viktor Hachmang (design), as the Flickr description states
Made
2014 (photographed 11 April 2014)
Style
Risograph (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Playful, vibrant, handmade
Evidence
Viewed the 1024 × 576 px Flickr “large” file of a close photograph of one printed copy, owned and photographed by Marcel van Schooten. The image shows a detail, not the whole sheet.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

The Flickr description says: “Printed on RISO printer with an awesome design by Viktor Hachmang.” The photo is licensed CC BY 2.0 by the photographer, who is not the designer.

Observed

  • Fluorescent pink and a dark blue are the only inks on cream paper.
  • A regular pink halftone dot field fills the background. A finer blue screen gives a light gray-blue tint.
  • Where blue lines and fills cross the pink, the overlap prints a dark violet.
  • Line drawing and lettering are clean and of even weight. There are no black key lines.

Why it belongs

A clear example of the two-ink riso poster: the third color is made by overprint, and halftone screens stand in for extra inks.

Borrow

Use a pink halftone as a background tint and let a second ink overprint it, instead of adding a third color.
